# KoreanDrama.org

> > A comprehensive resource for Korean drama information, featuring detailed guides to SBS melodramas and romantic series.

KoreanDrama.org provides in-depth coverage of Korean television dramas, including plot summaries, cast information, and production details. The site focuses on popular melodramas and romance series from major Korean broadcasters like SBS.
